I am actually looking into that too :D. I am a bit hesitant, since there is a lot of things to know, but I will try it eventually.

If you like high VG juices, it's pretty easy to jump into and you won't have to buy much. Basically you just need Vegetable Glycerine, Nicotine (using 36mg PG based solution alleviates the fear of getting it on your skin), and a single flavor. One of my favorite juices uses these three ingredients and Capellas Orange Creamsicle for the flavor (20%). There are e-juice calculators that takes all the guesswork out and using a 30 ml syringe with a blunt tip needle makes measuring the ingredients easy. After that, just play around with different flavor combinations. I made a delicious strawberry cheesecake recipe using flavors from The Flavor Apprentice's "most popular" 4 ml sample pack. It was amazing without steeping. Couldn't tell you how it was after it steeped 'cause it only lasted a day.

Oh yeah, the famous cheese cake. I lost my shit when I saw this flavor the first time. But I am more of a 50:50 guy, when it comes to Liquids. I am fine with a small cloud, I only care about a good flash and that is also dependent on the nicotine. I am vaping 18 mg, planning to reduce to 12 though.

My favorite flavor is actually Raspberries. Ordered a 50ml bottle 2 days ago and some Watermelon/Honeymelon/Mint mix. Curious how that turns out. But eventually I will settle on Raspberry probably.

You'd also need PG if you dropped to 12 mg, but at 18 mg half of your mix would be PG based nicotine. We both started at 18 mg but dropped down to 3 pretty quickly. Got tired of getting dizzy from vaping to frequently :)

I've still got a mostly full 250 ml jug of PG sitting unused at the moment. I may end up making some 50/50 blends to go in my tank as the heavy VG wicks pretty slowly into my rebuildable. I prefer less of a throat hit that the PG gives, but still want to see how it will do flavor-wise with some of my recipes.

I held out as long as I could, watching and waiting to see where the sands would shift in the fallout. Would the content keep flowing? Would the front page be readable.

Three, maybe four days is all it took. Several visits of lurking, refreshing. At first frantically hoping to see signs of life. Then more methodically, several hours would pass before setting foot on scorched ground again. Eventually a full 12 hour run. What I found, what I knew to be true, was that it's over.

The content had barely changed. Nothing new or engaging had crawled from the depths of New to make it anywhere near the front page. Rising was awash in political attempts to depose dear leader while simultaneously insulting her character. Both where we'll based but nothing I'd come to see.

Even the subs had fallen, many I'd visit often and were havens of original content somehow now felt hollow and whatever effect the fallout had overall, lingered even in the places where I'd least it expect it to have any touch at all.

No, home has been destroyed. It's gone, and like the charred remains of drought stricken seabeds, it will never return to its once faded glory. Voices still cry out there, voices of the few too blind or too niavie to see what's happened. That the well is dry and it's just a manner of time before they all die off due to thirst. These poor dammed souls. Perhaps they'll find their way down the road and escape but I look down to the ground and I know that I don't believe that. They'll wave their own flags in victory until the same flag wraps round their own throats and chokes them to ground with the rest of the dust.

And yet, there is hope. I've crossed the berm and settled here. A green land, fresh for cultivation. A home of free thought and honest discussion with out excessive censorship or moderation to the point of immobility. A new home. A chance to start over. I'll plant my first stake here.

My old name from the past abandoned to the dust from which I left. It feels good to start again clean.
